key_facts: Config resolution: opencode loads config in layers, merging from multiple sources
Global config files loaded in order: config.json, opencode.json, opencode.jsonc
Project config: .opencode/opencode.json or .opencode/opencode.jsonc (walks up from CWD)
OPENCODE_CONFIG env var: direct path to a specific config file
OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR env var: overrides the entire global config directory
OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT env var: inline config content as a string
OPENCODE_DISABLE_PROJECT_CONFIG env var: disables all .opencode/ project configs
--dir flag only changes CWD, does NOT change which config files are loaded
Config merging: later configs override earlier ones (merged, not replaced)
debug config shows the FINAL resolved config after all merges
call_chains: Config.loadInstanceState -> loads project from .opencode/{opencode.json,opencode.jsonc} walking up from CWD
Config.loadInstanceState -> if OPENCODE_CONFIG set, loads that file too
Config.loadInstanceState -> if OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR set, loads from that directory
blast_radius: Changing ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json affects ALL opencode sessions globally
Creating .opencode/opencode.json in a project makes it project-local
OPENCODE_CONFIG env var takes precedence for project config
OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR completely replaces global config directory
research_sources: DEBUG log output from opencode run --dir /tmp

data.for_supervisor: VERIFIED: Opencode config resolution uses layered merging with clear precedence. For project-specific config, the BEST option is to create .opencode/opencode.json in the project root. This gets loaded automatically and overrides global config. The --dir flag does NOT affect config loading. Alternative env vars: OPENCODE_CONFIG (direct file path), OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR (override config dir), OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT (inline config). Evidence: debug logs show exact loading order; binary source code confirms the resolution chain.
data.for_successor: If the task is to create a project-specific config, create .opencode/opencode.json in the project root with the desired config. It will be loaded automatically on top of the global ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json. The project config merges with (not replaces) the global config.
